title: Oil surges above $95 as US-Iran fighting escalates, Hormuz tanker attacks revive supply fears
summary: Oil jumped above $95/barrel as US airstrikes on Iran and attacks on two supertankers in the Strait of Hormuz revived supply disruption fears. Vessel crossings through Hormuz fell sharply; the waterway carries ~20% of global oil supply. WTI extended its 5.2% gain from the prior session.
why: 油价突破$95是今日全球资产最重要宏观驱动力：直接推高通胀预期、触发美联储9月16日加息再定价、压制风险资产。对持有科技/消费股 sell put 组合，本周 IV 明显抬升，需重新评估行权价安全边际。

title: Wall Street falls broadly: Nasdaq -1.03%, S&P 500 -0.70%, Dow -0.79%; 10Y Treasury hits 4.75%
summary: Rising oil prices and higher yields dragged all three major U.S. indexes lower on Sept 1. The 10-year Treasury yield hit 4.75%, its highest since January 2025, squeezing equity valuations across nearly every sector.
why: 美债收益率4.75%创年内新高，高利率环境直接压低成长股估值倍数（DCF折现率上升），并增加 sell put 行权价被击穿的尾部风险；组合 delta 需密切跟踪。

title: Semiconductor stocks clobbered: Intel -7%, AMD -5%, TSM -6% amid global bond selloff
summary: Chip stocks suffered their worst single-session loss in weeks on Sept 1 as rising Treasury yields triggered a valuation reset. Intel fell 7%, AMD dropped 5%, and Taiwan Semiconductor fell 6%; Nvidia and Micron also declined. Macro-driven selloff, not company-specific news.
why: 半导体是组合核心敞口（NVDA、INTC、MU、SK海力士），单日大幅回调显示利率上行对高估值芯片股冲击显著；IV 上升但行权价安全边际收窄，卖出 put 需重新评估。

title: Fed September 16 rate hike near-certain as Iran oil shock stokes inflation; markets in "doom loop"
summary: CNBC Daily Open described markets as trapped in an "Iran doom loop": oil surge → inflation fears → Fed hike bets → higher yields → equity selloff. A 25bp hike at the Sept 16 FOMC is now the base case; Fed funds currently at 3.50–3.75%. Three hawkish FOMC dissenters from the July meeting add pressure.
why: 美联储9月加息从预期变为近确定事件，对持仓科技股的 sell put 有双重压力：IV上升有利权利金但持仓股估值面临压缩；建议关注9月16日FOMC声明措辞对隐含波动率的影响。

title: 港股恒指跌1.1%，A股沪指跌0.16%：油价飙升叠加海外利率风险令亚洲市场承压
summary: 受美国-伊朗冲突致油价飙升拖累，港股恒生指数9月1日下跌1.1%，收于25324点；内地上证综指跌0.16%至3979.9点，深证成指跌1.02%。市场担忧通胀反弹将促使全球央行收紧货币政策。
why: 港股和A股同步下跌，腾讯、阿里、美团等持仓标的均有压力；油价冲击同时挤压消费端利润空间；HK 市场 IV 短期上升，sell put 期权溢价有望提升但需关注方向风险。

title: 中国8月官方制造业PMI升至49.8，高于预期49.7，连续改善但仍处收缩区间
summary: 国家统计局8月31日公布8月制造业PMI为49.8，高于7月的49.2及市场预期的49.7，环比改善但仍低于荣枯分界线50。生产指数（50.4%）和新订单指数（50.6%）重回扩张区间；装备制造业和高技术制造业PMI分别为51.4%和52.9%。
why: 制造业PMI超预期改善是A股边际正面信号，表明经济有温和韧性；但整体仍处收缩区间，对消费赛道持仓（海底捞、蜜雪冰城等）提示需求偏弱仍是制约因素。

title: Nvidia invests $3.5B in MediaTek convertible bonds to embed NVLink Fusion in rival AI chips
summary: Nvidia bought ~90% of MediaTek's record $3.9B convertible bond offering on Aug 31. MediaTek will adopt NVLink Fusion, integrating Nvidia's rack-scale interconnect into custom AI accelerators — meaning ASIC customers' chips will plug directly into Nvidia systems. Alphabet also participated. MediaTek jumped 10% on Sept 1.
why: 英伟达以$35亿美元锁定 MediaTek 的 AI 芯片生态，NVLink Fusion 嵌入等于确保 NVDA 在定制 AI 芯片时代的基础设施主导权；强化了不卖芯片就卖生态的护城河逻辑，是当前 NVDA sell put 组合的强劲正面催化剂。

title: CrowdStrike × Nvidia launch SafeMind: purpose-built frontier AI cybersecurity models
summary: CrowdStrike launched SafeMind on Sept 1, a family of security models built using Nvidia Nemotron open models. Includes Red Tempest (offensive) and Blue Solano (defensive) models, operating natively in the Falcon platform for autonomous threat response at machine speed — deepest Nvidia-CrowdStrike integration yet.
why: 英伟达与 CrowdStrike 深度绑定网络安全 AI 代理领域，强化了 NVDA 在 AI 基础设施的多元应用落地；为 NVDA 在非数据中心场景打开新的商业化路径，属于正面软催化剂。

title: Google's Waymo expands paid robotaxi rides to 14 US cities; adds Denver, San Diego, Tampa
summary: Waymo began public paid robotaxi rides in Denver, San Diego, and Tampa on Sept 1, reaching 14 US cities. Fleet exceeds 4,000 vehicles including the new Zeekr-built Ojai minivan. Amazon's Zoox simultaneously expanded, intensifying the autonomous vehicle race.
why: Waymo 快速扩展至14城显示 Alphabet 在自动驾驶商业化的竞争优势持续拉大，对 GOOGL 估值是正面信号；需关注明日 Tesla Cybercab 正式发布对自动驾驶赛道估值的重新梳理。

title: Palantir wins $127M in Army TITAN production contracts; AI targeting platform enters manufacturing phase
summary: The U.S. Army awarded $192M in production contracts on Sept 1: Palantir USG received $127M, Anduril $65M to produce eight TITAN (Tactical Intelligence Targeting Access Node) intelligence ground stations over 18 months. Partners include L3Harris, Sierra Nevada Corp., and WWT.
why: Palantir 将 TITAN 从原型推进到量产是其国防AI平台落地的关键里程碑；搭配 Q2 营收+93% YoY 的强劲势头，政府合同稳定性进一步降低 PLTR 的估值风险，对 sell put 策略有正面含义。注：信源为国防专业媒体 Defense Scoop，非白名单，暂标 verified=false。
